body:
Your launch review begins at 2:00 PM, with thirty minutes free beforehand.

Maya is waiting for your launch-date reply before the meeting. The rest of the afternoon is clear, so that reply is the only urgent follow-up.

chips.label: Draft my reply to Maya
chips.prompt: Draft a concise reply to Maya about the launch date.

chips.label: Prepare me for the review
chips.prompt: Prepare a short briefing for my launch review.

chips.label: Show the rest of my day
chips.prompt: Show the rest of my schedule today.
